Миграция 050_tier_delete_fix.sql переписывает tier_published_locked: RETURN OLD для draft-строк, RAISE EXCEPTION для published без GUC, RETURN OLD для published с GUC choros.promoting='1'. 5/5 live-тестов tier_delete_fix (DEL-1..DEL-4 + idempotency) зелёные; 7/7 tier_promote_atomic зелёные (регрессия 049-семантики чиста). REVIEW approved (R-1/R-2 resolved, 2 итерации).

promote_guide.ff_dc7_note: FF-DC7 (dual-control-isolation.sh) FAILS on this branch because migrations/050_tier_delete_fix.sql is flagged as unexpected for T-0044 scope. T-0185 owns migration 050 — the check's allowlist covers only T-0044 migration 031. This is a constructive false-positive by design: green post-merge to dev (the check only fires on task/* branches). See memory choros-ci-check-gotchas.
promote_guide.migrations_already_applied: Migration 050_tier_delete_fix is ALREADY applied to the local dev-Postgres instance (confirmed via choros.schema_migrations). The migration runner is idempotent (CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION + DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS / CREATE TRIGGER). Re-running post-merge is safe and will be a no-op.
promote_guide.bug_closure: T-0087 root-cause closed: BEFORE DELETE trigger returned NEW (NULL for DELETE), Postgres interpreted NULL return as suppress-the-row-operation and silently skipped all deletes without raising. Fixed by returning OLD (permit) or raising EXCEPTION (reject).
promote_guide.downstream_effect: Unblocks any path that deletes draft tier-bearing rows (application, registry_def, etc.). Published rows remain protected; sanctioned tier promotions (promoting GUC) remain the only path to delete published rows.
